title: Refund Amount of a Domain Care Price Match on a Manual Renewal, Domain Registrations
content:
**Refunds desk calculation note — Domain Registrations, Domain Care price match of a manual renewal charge**

## The charge that is matched

The charge is the domain's most recent manual renewal charge: the manual renewal charge line of the domain with the latest charge date. A domain is never billed two such charges on one day, and an older manual renewal charge is never price-matched. The price match is set for that charge only where it was billed from 1 January 2022 through 30 November 2025 and paid by card or PayPal; a most recent manual renewal charge billed on 1 December 2025 or later, or paid from account credit, has no Domain Care price-match refund. The years the charge covered are the years recorded on that charge line.

## The refund amount

The price-match refund is the charge's Domain Care credits, never more than the amount billed on the charge, rounded half up to the cent, and nothing is refunded where those credits come to zero.

The Domain Care credits of a manual renewal charge are the amounts named as one of the charge's Domain Care credits, added together, each read from the account's records on the day of the price match. Where no Domain Care credit applies to the charge, the credits come to zero and nothing is refunded.

In words, the refund is the lower of the Domain Care credits and the amount billed on the charge, in USD rounded half up to the cent; a credit total of zero gives no refund line at all.

## Worked examples on hypothetical figures

| Most recent manual renewal charge | Domain Care credits on the day of the price match | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| billed 9 August 2023 by card, USD 81.40 | USD 4.35 | USD 4.35 |
| billed 9 August 2023 by PayPal, USD 3.10 | USD 5.20 | USD 3.10 (never more than the amount billed) |
| billed 9 August 2023 by card, USD 81.40 | none | nothing |
| billed 30 November 2025 by card, USD 81.40 | USD 2.75 | USD 2.75 (last day of the billing window) |
| billed 1 December 2025 by card | any | no price-match refund |
| billed 9 August 2023 from account credit | any | no price-match refund |

Where an older manual renewal charge of the same domain was billed in 2022 and a later one in 2026, only the 2026 charge is the most recent one, and it falls outside the billing window, so neither is price-matched.
